notes.subject: מאיבי
notes.gloss-note: 'adversaries' is not strong enough; 'ba ba mphapanang' expresses active opposition
notes.rationale: Hebrew noun from the verb 'to hate', i.e. personal enemies; Sepedi 'ba ba mphapanang' captures hostile opponents

notes.subject: לעולם היא לי
notes.rationale: Literal: 'it is to me forever'; rendered as 'they remain with me always' to match the sense, following the traditional reading

translation: Ke nne le temogo ye ntsi go feta ba ba mphapanang, ka gobane melawana ya gago ke setsego le nna ka dinako tsose.

tokens.gloss: ke nne le temogo ye ntsi
